@@ -97,6 +97,10 @@ User-local Mission Control discovery requires remote agent hosts and AI features

The Mission Control hosts picker displays cached inventory immediately and refreshes on opening. The workspace picker also starts host discovery after showing its cached remote entries on a fresh open; internal list rebuilds reuse the in-flight or completed inventory instead of restarting discovery.

+Local Mission Control sharing separates filesystem grants, the browsing default, and the project catalogue. Sharing grants the host's home directory and local project folders outside it, and creates `~/.copilot` as the advertised default directory. The Agents Window supplies local-disk recent folders from its workspace-picker history as catalogue entries, including the picker's worktree-collapsing behavior; remote and virtual folders are excluded. Missing folders are omitted with a warning. Other editor windows supply their open local workspace folders. Catalogue updates do not require a relay reconnect, and neither home nor the default directory becomes a project unless explicitly included in the folder inventory.

+Selecting Environments from the Agents workspace picker connects through the shared environment command, then opens the connected provider's folder-browse action. Accepting a folder selects it for a new session with the exact remote provider; cancelling either picker does not change the workspace selection.

The Mission Control contribution registers a generic native provider for each inventory host before connection, using that host's actual advertised agents and session URIs once connected. Disconnect retains the provider, cached summaries, and drafts, with disconnected sessions read-only. Mission Control owns host inventory; providers expose `canRemove: false`, so host management surfaces offer no local hide or remove action. Restoring a previously open chat may invoke the existing on-demand session connection path, which validates host availability for new attachments and never provisions replacement compute. Account changes withdraw the old providers and cancel pending operations. Session summaries and local display-name overrides are account/profile-scoped without changing connection addresses, session routing identity, or migrating historical storage. The shared remote-host display-name API delegates to the inventory owner for these labels.

User-local connection requests reuse a healthy attachment or join its ongoing establishment or recovery. Concurrent requests share admission; cancelling a joining caller does not cancel the shared operation, and a joining caller's deadline does not disconnect client-owned background recovery. New attachments still validate Mission Control availability before minting credentials.
